pages.title: Home
pages.description: Koinonia Experience is the annual family conference of Christ Connect Family Church, held in Lusaka, Zambia every December. Editions Koi 24', Koi 25' and the upcoming Koi 26'.
pages.text: Deep in Christ. One in Fellowship. Sent to Multiply. Once a year the whole Christ Connect family comes home to Lusaka: three days of worship, the Word and fellowship that sends us back out multiplying. I am coming to Koi 26' Watch Koi 25' Next Koi 26', December 2026 Where Lusaka, Zambia Last theme "Going Deep and Multiplying" What Koinonia is about Deep in Christ. One in Fellowship. Sent to Multiply. 01 Christ-centred encounter Deepening our relationship with Jesus Christ. 02 Authentic fellowship Growing together in love, unity and community. 03 Biblical formation Being equipped through the Word for life and ministry. 04 Missional multiplication Sent out to make disciples and expand God's Kingdom. Our purpose To encounter Christ deeply, live in fellowship genuinely, be formed biblically, and multiply faithfully. Our promise Every participant leaves spiritually renewed, relationally strengthened, biblically equipped and missionally activated to impact the world. Biblical foundation Acts 2:42-47 1 John 1:3 Philippians 2:1-2 2 Timothy 2:2 John 15:4-5 , 16 Every Koinonia Experience Past Koi 24' 21 to 22 December 2024 Two days in Ibex Hill where the family first gathered under the Koinonia name: worship, the Word, and members sharing preaching, songs, dance, poems and testimonies. Open K24 Past Koi 25' "Going Deep and Multiplying" 19 to 21 December 2025 . Grace Exploits Event Center Open K25 Coming soon December 2026 Next Koi 26' " To be announced " 18 to 20 December 2026 . Lusaka Open K26 3 days together every December 3+ nations in the room: Zambia, Zimbabwe, Malawi 5 leaders taught at Koi 25' 1 family under Christ What Koinonia means Koinonia is the New Testament word for fellowship: sharing life, not just a room. "They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and to fellowship." Acts 2:42. The conference exists so that churches spread across borders remember they are one body, go deep in the Word together, and go home to multiply. From Koi 25' Praise and Worship Medley: Chawama, Hallelujah Hosanna Worship Connect, K25 Praise Medley: You Are So Good, Bena Ba Suma Kuli Ine Worship Connect, K25 Come home this December. Koinonia is where the family remembers it is one body. Whether you belong to a CCFC church or you are curious, there is a seat for you at Koi 26'. I am coming to Koi 26' Visit CCFC Zambia

Moments Photographs from this edition are being added. Questions Before you register. The things people ask the office most about Koinonia. Who can come to Koinonia? Everyone is welcome: members, friends and first-time guests from every CCFC church in Zambia, Zimbabwe, Malawi and the wider family. When and where is Koi 26'? Koi 26' is in December 2026 in Lusaka. The exact dates, venue and theme will be announced on this page first. How much does it cost? Delegate fees: Adults Zambia (13+) K500. Children Zambia (12 and below) K250. Adults International (13+) USD 25. Children International (12 and below) USD 10. Zambia delegates include both Lusaka based and out of town participants travelling from within Zambia. International delegates are participants travelling from outside Zambia. Registration is confirmed once the applicable delegate fee has been paid. Can I register my children? Yes. Koinonia is a family conference. Fill in the form for each child and choose their age range. Can I take part by preaching, singing or performing? Yes. Choose Yes on the form and tell us what you would like to share. Slots are limited and the organisers will confirm. How do I know my registration went through? A thank-you message appears on the page as soon as you register. The team will then contact you with the dates and delegate rates. Who do I ask if I have a question? WhatsApp the church office on +260 573 762 913, call +260 772 890 854, or email info@ccfczambia.org. Come home this December. Koinonia is where the family remembers it is one body.
